宀.ja: Written like katakana ウ (u) + かんむり (top).
宀.cn: Began as a picture of a house.

semantic.why: Someone received under your roof (宀).
Began as a person resting on a mat; the roof (宀) marks it as indoors.
First meant to sit at ease, settled at home (宀).

夂.ja: Written like katakana ノ (no) + 又 (また, again).
夂.cn: Began as a picture of a footprint pointing down. The same shape was also an old picture of a knot at the end of a rope, the early form of 終 (end).

semantic.why: A foot (夂) coming to an entrance (口): it first meant to arrive.
A foot (夂) held back by a thread (幺), lagging behind.

冫.ja: に (二, two) + すい (水, water): 氵 with two strokes instead of three.
冫.cn: The squeezed form of 仌, a picture of two blocks of ice.

semantic.why: Cold, like ice (冫).
Freezing turns water to ice (冫).

广.ja: ま (麻, hemp) + だれ (たれ, top-left): the hanging part of 麻.
广.cn: A picture of a building with a roof. Some believe it shows one with three walls, open on one side.

semantic.why: A shop is a building (广).
A storehouse is a building (广).

隹.ja: ふる (古, old) + とり (鳥, bird): the bird part of 舊, the old form of 旧 (old).
隹.cn: A picture of a short-tailed bird, like a sparrow.

semantic.why: First a male bird (隹), then any male.
First a female bird (隹), then any female.

青.cn: Some believe it combines 生 (growing plants) and 丹 (cinnabar red), the color of young plants. Others see 生 and 井, both giving the sound.

⺡.ja: さん (三, three) + すい (水, water).
⺡.cnNote: Written as three strokes on the left side.

semantic.why: Swimming is done in water (氵).
A sea is a great body of water (氵).
Washing is done with water (氵).

⺅.ja: にん (人, person) + べん (へん, left side).
⺅.cnNote: Squeezed to fit the left side.

semantic.why: A person leaning against a tree (木), resting.
A person (亻) staying put in one place: to live there.
A person (亻) at work: to make.

⺘.ja: て (手, hand) + へん (left side).
⺘.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the left side.

semantic.why: Holding is done with the hand (扌).
Hitting is done with the hand (扌).
Throwing is done with the hand (扌).

⺾.ja: くさ (草, grass) + かんむり (top).
⺾.cn: The top form of 艸, a picture of blades of grass.

semantic.why: A flower is a plant (艹).
Grass is a plant (艹).
Tea is made from a plant's (艹) leaves.

⻌.ja: し (之, which it looks like) + にょう (bottom-left). しにょう later became しんにょう.
⻌.cn: The combining form of 辵: 彳 (walk) + 止 (foot), walking along.

semantic.why: Going along (辶) with someone to see them off.
A bird (隹) on the move (辶): a bird only goes forward, so advance.
Some believe walking (辶) with the head (首) leading the way.

亠.ja: なべ (鍋, pot) + ぶた (蓋, lid): it looks like a pot lid.
亠.cn: A lid with a handle on top. In many kanji the shape stands for other things, like a roof (高, 京) or a head (交).

冖.ja: Written like katakana ワ (wa) + かんむり (top).
冖.cn: A cloth used to cover something.

semantic.why: A hand (寸) placing a cap (冖) on a head (元).
A cloth cover (冖) over the sun (日): dark.

儿.cn: A picture of a standing person, the form of 人 used at the bottom.

semantic.why: A mouth (口) over a person (儿): the one giving orders, the older brother.
A person (儿) with a big eye (目) on top.

𠆢.ja: ひと (人, person) + やね (屋根, roof).
𠆢.cn: Not one thing: a person (人) in 介 and 企, but a mouth turned down (亼) in 今, 合 and 令, and a roof in 余.

semantic.why: A person (𠆢) with a mark on each side: in between.
A person (𠆢) standing on tiptoe (止) to look ahead.

冂.ja: けい (冂, its own reading) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).
冂.cn: Some believe it shows the land outside a city's walls; others see the side view of a building, an early form of 堂.

勹.ja: つつみ (包, wrap) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).
勹.cn: A picture of a person bending over, an ancient form of 包 (wrap).

幺.ja: いと (糸, thread) + がしら (top): the top of 糸.
幺.cn: A picture of a silk thread, which came to mean tiny.

semantic.why: Tiny (幺) strength (力): a young child.
Thread (幺) tying a foot (夂), so it lags behind.

厶.cn: Some believe it shows something circling around oneself, the original form of 私 (private); others see a simplified 牟.

丷.ja: はち (八, eight) + がしら (top).

丶.cn: A small flame on a torch, the original form of 主.

一.cn: A single horizontal stroke for the number one.

口.cn: A picture of an open mouth.

semantic.why: Tasting is done with the mouth (口).
Breathing in is done through the mouth (口).
Calling out comes from the mouth (口).

日.cn: A picture of the sun; the stroke in the middle sets it apart from 口.

semantic.why: Clear weather: the sun (日) is out.
Dark: without the sun (日).
Yesterday is a day (日) that has passed.

木.cn: A picture of a tree: branches on top, roots at the bottom.

semantic.why: Two trees (木): many trees together.
A board is made of wood (木).
A pillar is a wooden (木) post.

土.cn: A picture of a mound of earth.

semantic.why: Land is the earth (土) underfoot.
A place is a piece of ground (土).
A slope is sloping ground (土).

十.cn: Some believe a single vertical stroke, the next step above one; others see the original form of 針 (needle), borrowed for ten.

semantic.why: 十 marks it as a number: ten hundreds.
Many (十) forces (力) pulling together: cooperate.

nameNotes.よこめ: 目 turned on its side, written 罒. In most kanji, though, 罒 is a net (⺲).

目.cn: A picture of an eye, later stood upright.

semantic.why: An eyeball is part of the eye (目).
Sleeping is done with the eyes (目) closed.
A hand (手) over the eyes (目), gazing far: to watch.

小.cn: Some believe three small dots, meaning small; others see three grains of sand, the original form of 沙.

田.cn: A picture of a field divided into sections.

semantic.why: A boundary is the edge of a field (田).
Strength (力) for work in the fields (田).
Walking around a field (田) to trace its edge → outline, shorten.

月.cn: A picture of a crescent moon. A look-alike part, ⺼, is a squeezed 肉 (meat), not the moon.

semantic.why: Bright, like the moon (月).
A person looking up at the moon (月): to gaze, then to hope.

大.cn: A picture of a person standing, seen from the front.

semantic.why: A standing person (大) with the head marked: the top, then the sky.
Began as a variant of 大, a standing person.

貝.cn: A picture of a cowrie shell, once used as money.

semantic.why: Shells (貝) were money: wealth.
Things worth shells (貝), that is, money.

糸.cn: A picture of a skein of silk.

semantic.why: A line is like a thread (糸).
Tying is done with thread (糸).
Silk (糸) marks it as a fiber material: paper.

言.cn: Built on 口 (mouth); what the mark above it shows is uncertain.

semantic.why: Talking is done with words (言).
Words (言) in use: language.
Saying words (言) aloud from a text: to read.

心.cn: A picture of a heart, now highly stylized.

semantic.why: The heart (心) was seen as the seat of thought.
Forgetting happens in the mind (心).

乙.cn: Origin unclear: some believe a sprouting plant, others a fish's gut or a flow of water.

semantic.why: 乙 here is the tangled end of a thread: disorder.
乙 here means rising up high; the meaning shifted to "dry".

亅.ja: はね (跳ね, flick) + ぼう (棒, stick): a stick with a hook.
亅.cn: A hook stroke; few kanji use it for meaning, and 予 and 事 are filed under it by shape.

二.cn: Two parallel strokes for the number two.

人.cn: A side view of a standing person, showing an arm and a leg.

semantic.why: A person (人) shut inside an enclosure (囗): a prisoner.
Two people (人) sitting on the ground (土) inside a building (广): a seat.

八.cn: Two lines turning away from each other, first meaning “to split”. The Chinese word for eight (today bā) sounded the same, so it was written with this character, and “split” moved to 分 and 別.

几.ja: き (几, its reading) + にょう (bottom-left).
几.cn: A small stool seen from the side.

凵.ja: かん (凵, its reading) + にょう (bottom-left).
凵.cn: A picture of a pit or cave.

semantic.why: A knife (刀) cutting something in two (八).
Cutting is done with a knife (刀).
Two wooden pieces were notched with a knife (刀); matching notches proved a deal. So: a ticket or certificate.

力.cn: Some believe an arm bent at the elbow; others see a wooden plough.

semantic.why: Moving something takes force (力).
A field (田) and strength or a plough (力): a man working the field.
Adding more force (力): add.

匚.ja: はこ (箱, box) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).

匸.ja: かくし (隠し, hiding) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).
匸.cn: A sign for something hidden away.

卜.cn: Perhaps a crack in an oracle bone, read to tell the future.

卩.ja: ふし (節, joint) + づくり (つくり, right side).
卩.cn: A kneeling person seen from the side.

semantic.why: A mouth above a kneeling person (卩): giving orders.
A hand (爪) pressing down on a kneeling person (卩): to press, then a seal pressed onto paper.
A person on a cliff (厃) above a kneeling person (卩): danger.

厂.ja: がん (厂, its reading) + だれ (たれ, top-left).
厂.cn: A picture of a cliff face.

semantic.why: Water springing out under a cliff (厂): a source.
A cliff (厂) of thick, hard rock: thick.
A mountain (山) cliff (厂), then the steep bank of a river: shore.

又.cn: A picture of a right hand.

semantic.why: A hand (又) taking the ear (耳) of a hunted animal as proof of the kill: to take.
Hands (爪 and 又) passing something from one to another.

囗.ja: くに (国, country) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).

semantic.why: A garden is an enclosed (囗) area.
Firm: enclosed (囗) on all sides.
A person (人) shut inside an enclosure (囗): a prisoner.

士.cn: A picture of a war axe; it came to mean soldier, then officer.

夊.ja: なつ (夏, summer) + あし (bottom): the bottom part of 夏.
夊.cn: A footprint pointing down, a variant of 夂.

夕.cn: A picture of a crescent moon.

semantic.why: Night is when the moon (夕) is out.
Some believe: saying your name (口) so you are known in the dark of evening (夕).

女.cn: A picture of a woman kneeling with folded arms.

semantic.why: A wife is a woman (女).
Marriage is taking a wife (女).
A woman (女) with a child (子): good, fond of.

子.cn: A picture of a baby with a big head and spread arms, its legs wrapped in a blanket.

semantic.why: A child (子) continuing the family line.
A woman (女) with a child (子): good, fond of.

寸.cn: A hand with a mark at the wrist, where the pulse is felt; it became a small unit of length.

semantic.why: A hand (寸) handing something to a person (亻): to attach, to give.
Leading by the hand (寸).

尢.ja: だい (大, big) の まげあし (曲げ足, bent legs): 大 with bent legs.
尢.cn: A person with bent legs, jumping or collapsing; 大 has straight legs.

尸.cn: A person with bent legs, sitting or lying; as a part it often stands for a body.

semantic.why: The tail at the end of a body (尸).
A body (尸) settled in a place.

屮.ja: くさ (草, grass) + の + め (芽, sprout).
屮.cn: A picture of a sprouting plant.

semantic.why: A mountain (山) in the sea.
Rock from a mountain (山).
A mountain (山) jutting into the sea.

巛.ja: まがり (曲がり, bent) + がわ (かわ, river).

工.ja: 工 can be read たくみ (craftsman).
工.cn: Some believe a bladed tool for marking borders; others see a carpenter's square.

semantic.why: Fine work (工): skillful.
A left hand holding a tool (工).

已.cn: It may first have been the same character as 巳, a snake or a fetus.

巾.ja: はば (幅, width): 巾 was used as a short form of 幅.

semantic.why: Linen is a cloth (巾).
A curtain is a hanging cloth (巾).
A seat was a cloth (巾) mat.

干.cn: Some believe a shield with feathers on top; others see a forked hunting weapon.

廴.ja: えん (延, extend) + にょう (bottom-left): the bottom-left part of 延.
廴.cn: A person with one leg behind: a long stride.

廾.ja: にじゅう (二十, twenty) + あし (bottom): it looks like 廿 (twenty) at the bottom.

semantic.why: Two hands (廾) holding a weapon (戈): on guard.

semantic.concepts: tinker with, tamper with, play with
semantic.why: Two hands (廾) playing with jade (王).

弋.ja: いぐるみ (弋, an arrow with a cord, for catching birds).

semantic.why: Drawing a bow (弓): pull.
Stretching a bowstring (弓): stretch.

彡.ja: さん (三, three) + づくり (つくり, right side): three strokes on the right.
彡.cn: Three strands of hair; in some kanji, rays of light.

semantic.why: Light rays (彡) and the shadow they cast.
Strokes (彡) marking a form.

彳.ja: ぎょうにん (行人, going person) + べん (へん, left side): the left half of 行.
彳.cn: The left half of 行, a street crossing seen from above.

semantic.why: Waiting on the road (彳).
Going back along the road (彳).

戈.cn: A picture of a dagger-axe, a weapon with a single blade.

semantic.why: Two hands holding a dagger-axe (戈): on guard.
A person (人) with a dagger-axe (戈): striking down.

戸.cn: One half of 門 (gate): a single door.

semantic.concepts: front door, hinged door, title page
semantic.why: A hinged door, a kind of door (戸).
A room behind a door (戸).
A fist is a closed hand (手).
The palm is the flat of the hand (手).
A hand (手) over the eyes, gazing far away.

攵.ja: ぼく (攴, strike) + づくり (つくり, right side).
攵.cn: A hand holding a tool or stick: to hit; written 攵 as a part.

semantic.why: Driving away (攵): let go.
Striking (攵) to make change.
Making things right (正) by force (攵): to govern.

文.cn: A person with a painted or tattooed chest; the tattoo later disappeared from the shape.

semantic.why: Beautiful patterns (文).
A spotted pattern (文).

斗.ja: ます (斗's own Japanese reading: a measure) + づくり (つくり, right side).
斗.cn: A ladle-shaped dipper used to measure grain. Later measures were boxes (枡); in Japanese, both 斗 and 枡 are read ます.

semantic.why: Measuring (斗) rice (米): materials, then fees.
Measuring (斗) grain (禾): sorting into kinds.

斤.ja: おの (斧, axe) + づくり (つくり, right side).

semantic.why: Wood cut with an axe (斤): freshly cut, new.
Breaking off with an axe (斤).
Splitting wood (木) with an axe (斤).

方.cn: Origin uncertain; possibly linked to a sign for the four sides of the world.

无.cn: Origin unknown; probably an old variant of 元, 天 or 堯.

曰.ja: ひら (平, flat) + び (日, sun): a flat 日.
曰.cn: A mouth (口) with words or breath coming out.

欠.cn: A kneeling person with the mouth wide open.

semantic.why: Singing with an open mouth (欠).
Blowing with an open mouth (欠).
Drinking with an open mouth (欠).

止.cn: A footprint pointing up, first meaning foot.

semantic.why: A foot (止) marching with a dagger-axe (戈).
One foot (止) in front of the other.
Feet (止) by a person (匕): where one stops, here.
Remains (歹) of a person.
Dying (歹) for a lord or a cause.

殳.ja: Written like katakana ル (ru) + また (又, again).
殳.cn: A hand holding a hammer-like tool: striking, action.

semantic.why: Striking (殳) down.
Going (彳) with a weapon (殳) in hand to guard the border: service, duty.

毋.cn: Borrowed from 母 (mother) and later changed: the two dots became one stroke.

比.cn: Some read it as two spoons (匕); the Shuowen sees two people side by side.

氏.cn: Origin debated: some see a person sowing a field, others a tree root or a clan's staff.

气.ja: き (気, air) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).

semantic.why: Water (水) coming out of the ground.
Ice is frozen water (水).
Water (水) from the body (尸).
Burning is what fire (火) does.
Smoke is what a fire (火) gives off.
Bursting with fire (火).

爪.cn: A hand grabbing from above; it can mean a claw.

semantic.why: Hands (爪 and 又) passing something from one to another.
A hand (爪) calming a woman (女) → calm, settle.

父.cn: A hand holding a stone axe: a man at work.

爻.cn: Two stacked X marks; possibly stalks used for divination, or marks for crossing.

爿.ja: しょう (爿, its reading) + へん (left side).

片.cn: A mirror image of 爿 (a bed); the Shuowen reads it as half a tree.

牛.cn: A bull's head with two horns and two ears.

semantic.why: Herding cattle (牛).
First a prize bull (牛), then anything special.
An animal (牛) offered as a sacrifice.

犬.cn: A dog seen from the side.

semantic.why: A dog (犬) lying beside a person (人).
First "hunting": a weapon (單) and a dog (犬).

玄.cn: Two twisted threads (幺) with a mark on top: a rope.

王.cn: A ritual axe, perhaps of jade, a sign of the king's power.

瓜.cn: A melon hanging from its vine.

瓦.cn: Fired pottery, or a roof tile.

甘.cn: Something sweet held in an open mouth.

生.ja: うまれる (生まれる, be born).
生.cn: A sprout (屮) coming out of the ground (一).

semantic.why: Being born (生): giving birth; 彦 gives the sound.
Born (生) of a woman (女): the family line you are born into, a surname.

用.cn: Formed by adding a handle to 同.

疋.ja: ひき (匹's reading): 疋 was also written for 匹.

nameNotes.ひきへん: On the left side 疋 changes shape, as in 疎.

疋.cn: A leg below the knee, with the foot (止) at the bottom, like 足. It was also written for 匹, which in the Han dynasty measured a length of woven cloth: hence “bolt of cloth”.

疒.ja: やまい (病, illness) + だれ (たれ, top-left).

semantic.why: Being sick (疒) in bed.
Pain, a kind of sickness (疒).
Being worn out, a kind of sickness (疒).

癶.ja: はつ (発, depart) + がしら (top): the top of 発.
癶.cn: A left and a right foot pointing apart.

白.cn: Two theories: an acorn, or a human head.

semantic.why: First "strikingly white (白)", then "clear"; "target" is a borrowed meaning.
白 here means "to say": people (比) all saying the same thing.

皮.cn: A hand (又) stripping the fur from an animal's hide.

皿.cn: An empty vessel, like a cup with handles.

semantic.why: A large dish (皿): a tray, a board.
Water overflowing a vessel (皿): more than enough.

矛.cn: A bamboo spear with a ring in the middle.

semantic.why: An arrow (矢) served as a measure of length: short.
Making something as straight as an arrow (矢) shaft → correct.

石.cn: A stone chime; 口 was added later as decoration.

semantic.why: Sand is tiny stones (石).
Breaking stone (石).
Grinding with a stone (石).
Offerings at an altar (示).
An altar (示) under a roof (宀): an ancestral temple.

禸.ja: じゅう (禸, its reading) + の + あし (bottom).
禸.cn: The Shuowen sees the print of an animal's paw; others link it to the bottoms of 萬, 禽 and 禹.

禾.ja: のぎ (禾, grain awn) + へん (left side).
禾.cn: A plant stalk with drooping grain.

semantic.why: Grain (禾) for sowing.
Grain (禾) worked with a sharp blade (刂): the crop it brings is a profit.

穴.cn: Possibly the entrance of a cave, or a door flap.

semantic.why: Empty space, like a hole (穴).
A cave, a hole (穴) in rock.

立.cn: A person standing on the ground.

semantic.why: Where a person (亻) stands (立) at court: rank, position.
Standing (立) up straight: proper; 耑 gives the sound, and 端 also came to mean edge.
Flour is ground rice (米).
A grain, like rice (米).
Sugar is sweetness made from grain (米).

缶.ja: みず (水, water) + がめ (瓶, jar).
缶.cn: An earthenware jar with a lid.

semantic.why: A flock of sheep (羊).
A person (大) wearing a headdress of ram's horns or feathers (羊).
羊 here stands for "good, auspicious", not sheep.
A wing, made of feathers (羽).
Flying on wings (羽).

耂.ja: おい (老い, old age) + かんむり (top).
耂.cn: A bent figure with long hair, an old person, as in 老 and 孝.

而.ja: しこうして (而して, and then).

耒.ja: らい (耒, its reading) + すき (鋤, plough).
耒.cn: A plough for turning the soil, or its handle.

semantic.why: Hearing is done with the ear (耳).
A hand (又) taking an ear (耳).

聿.ja: ふで (筆, brush) + づくり (つくり, right side).

semantic.why: Writing with a brush (聿).
A hand (聿) setting a pole into a base: build.

肉.cn: An animal's ribs, or a slice of meat; beside other parts it is written 月.

臣.cn: An eye looking down; it came to mean servant, then minister.

自.cn: A picture of a nose, later borrowed for self.

semantic.why: The nose (自, first a picture of a nose).
Breathing through the nose (自).
A smell is what the nose (自) notices.

至.cn: An arrow stuck in the ground: arriving.

semantic.why: Arriving (至) at a place.
Seeing someone all the way there (至): send, deliver.

舌.cn: A forked tongue coming out of a mouth (口).

舛.ja: まい (舞, dance) + あし (bottom): the bottom of 舞.
舛.cn: Two feet facing the same way.

semantic.why: A boat (舟); 㕣 gives the sound.
Sailing a boat (舟).
A warship is a boat (舟).

艮.cn: A person (人) looking back (目): turning away, a limit.

色.cn: A hand pressing down on a kneeling person; later borrowed for color.

虍.ja: とら (虎, tiger) + がしら (top).

semantic.why: A tiger (虍) tearing at prey with its claws: cruel.
First a tiger-like (虍) animal; "fear" is a borrowed meaning.

虫.cn: A snake; it was later used for 蟲 (insects).

semantic.why: A snake: what 虫 first showed.
A mosquito, a small creature counted with insects (虫).
A bee, an insect (虫).

血.cn: A drop of blood in a sacrificial cup (皿).

行.ja: ぎょう (行, go) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).

semantic.why: A crossroads (行): a street, a town.
First a lane (行) in a village; "technique" is a borrowed meaning.
Going around (行) a village on guard: protect.

衣.cn: The upper part of a garment, around the chest.

semantic.why: The inside of clothing (衣).
Cutting cloth (衣).
Making clothes (衣).

西.cn: Some believe a bird's nest; the meaning west was borrowed.

見.cn: An eye (目) on top of a kneeling person (卩).

semantic.why: Early forms were nearly the same as 見 (see); 示 was added for the sound.
Watching (見) closely → observe.
Looking (見) over something → view, read through.
Holding the horn (角) and cutting an ox (牛) apart with a knife (刀).
Butting with horns (角), then "touch".

谷.cn: A valley opening (口) between two mountain walls.

豆.cn: A kind of vessel; later borrowed for bean.

semantic.why: A pig (豕) raised for meat (⺼).
Walking (辶) after a pig (豕): chase.

豸.ja: むじな (狢, badger) + へん (left side).

赤.cn: A person (大) by a fire (火): the color of fire.

semantic.why: Getting up and going (走).
Running (走) past.
Running (走) beyond.
A wheel of a cart (車).
Carrying by cart (車).

辛.cn: Some see new tree shoots; it was traditionally read as a tool for marking slaves and criminals.

辰.ja: しん (辰, its reading) の たつ (dragon, its zodiac animal).
辰.cn: Some believe a farming tool, perhaps made of a clam shell; others see a person holding onto a cliff.

semantic.why: Clearing weeds in a field (田) with a shell blade (辰): farming.
A hand (寸) cutting grass with a shell blade (辰); "shame" is a borrowed meaning.

邑.cn: An enclosure (囗) with a kneeling person: a town.

酉.ja: ひよみ (日読み, the twelve zodiac animals) + の + とり (bird): 酉's zodiac animal is the rooster.
酉.cn: A wine jar with a pointed bottom.

semantic.why: Sour, like a fermented drink (酉).
Sobering up after drinking (酉).

釆.ja: Written like katakana ノ (no) + 米 (こめ, rice).
釆.cn: Some see an animal's paw with spread toes; others a plough scattering seeds.

里.cn: A field (田) and earth (土): a measure of land, a place.

金.cn: Blocks of metal, with 亼 giving the sound; the Shuowen saw metal buried in the earth.

semantic.why: Silver is a metal (金).
Iron is a metal (金).
A needle made of metal (金).

長.cn: An old person with long hair.

門.ja: もん (門, gate) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).

semantic.why: Opening a gate (門).
Closing a gate (門).

阜.ja: こ (小, small) + ざと (さと, village): named in contrast to おおざと (邑).
阜.cn: A hill with steps going up its side.

隶.ja: れい (隷, servant) + づくり (つくり, right side): the right part of 隷.
隶.cn: One reading: a hand (又) grabbing a tail (尾).

雨.cn: A cloud with raindrops falling from it.

非.cn: Two wings facing apart; later borrowed for not.

面.cn: A face with an exaggerated eye.

革.ja: つくり (作り, made) + がわ (かわ, hide): processed hide, leather.
革.cn: A stretched animal hide: head at the top, tail and legs below.

semantic.why: Shoes made of leather (革).
A ball made of leather (革).

韋.ja: なめしがわ (鞣し革, tanned leather).
韋.cn: Footprints around an enclosure; borrowed for tanned leather.

韭.cn: A leek growing out of the ground (一).

音.cn: Built like 言 with an extra stroke in the mouth, perhaps a muffled voice.

semantic.why: An echo is a sound (音).
Rhyme is a matter of sound (音).

頁.ja: おお (大, big) + がい (かい, 貝, shell): it looks like 貝 with a line on top.
頁.cn: The head of a kneeling person, meaning head; later borrowed for page.

semantic.why: 頁 already drew a head; 豆 was added for the sound.
A title is the head (頁) of a piece of writing.

風.cn: Written for its sound: 凡 over a feather, which later turned into 虫.

食.cn: A lid or mouth (亼) over a bowl of food.

semantic.why: Food (食), a meal; 反 gives the sound.
Feeding (食) animals.
Having eaten (食) enough.

首.cn: The head of an animal with a long mouth and horns.

香.cn: Millet (黍) and a mouth; perhaps millet made into a fermented drink.

馬.cn: A horse with a flowing mane; its legs became four dots.

semantic.why: Riding a horse (馬).
A horse (馬) standing still: to stop and stay.

骨.cn: A picture of bones, with 肉 (flesh) added later.

semantic.why: Remains are bones (骨).
The center of a bone (骨): marrow, then the core of something.

髟.ja: かみ (髪, hair) + かんむり (top).

鬥.ja: たたかい (闘い, fight) + がまえ (かまえ, enclosure).
鬥.cn: Two people face to face, fighting with bare hands.

鬯.ja: におい (匂い, scent) + ざけ (さけ, 酒, sake).
鬯.cn: A vessel of sacrificial wine made with millet and herbs.

鬼.cn: A kneeling figure with an ugly face, perhaps a mask.

semantic.why: A spirit of the dead (鬼).
A demon (鬼); 麻 gives the sound.
A sea creature counted as a fish (魚).
Catching fish (魚).
Fresh, like just-caught fish (魚).

鳥.cn: A bird with a dangling tail.

semantic.why: A bird (鳥) with an open mouth (口): singing.
A crane, a kind of bird (鳥).

鹿.cn: A deer; its antlers, head and legs became highly abstract.

semantic.why: Two deer (鹿) walking side by side; then "beautiful".
A mythical deer-like (鹿) animal.

麦.cn: Some believe 來 first drew wheat; when 來 was borrowed for "come", 麥 added a foot (夊) below to mean wheat.

黄.cn: Some believe it first drew a person with a swollen chest or belly; it was borrowed for "yellow" very early.

黍.cn: A grain plant (禾) with water or kernels below.

黒.cn: A Japanese simplified form of 黑.

黹.ja: ぬいとり (縫い取り, embroidery).
黹.cn: Perhaps a cloud-like decoration used on bronzes and clothing.

黽.cn: A frog with a small tail.

鼎.cn: A bronze vessel with three legs, for cooking and rituals.

鼓.cn: A drum (壴) and a hand with a stick (支).

鼠.cn: A rat: an open mouth with teeth on top, feet and tail below.

鼻.cn: 自 (a nose) with 畀 added, after 自 came to mean self.

齊.cn: Rows of neatly arranged fruits or thorns.

歯.cn: A mouth full of teeth; 止 was added later for the sound.

竜.cn: An old form of 龍, recorded in the Kangxi dictionary.

亀.cn: A Japanese simplified form of 龜.

龠.cn: A bamboo pan flute; a mouth (亼) on top shows it being played.

⺉.ja: りっ (立, standing) + とう (刀, knife): a knife standing on the right.
⺉.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the right side.

semantic.why: Cutting (刂) apart: separate.
Cutting (刂) into parts: divide.
Cutting (刂) in two (半): judging between two sides.

⺌.ja: しょう (小, small) + かんむり (top): 小 written on top.

川.ja: さんぼん (三本, three lines) + がわ (かわ, river).

巳.ja: おのれ (己, oneself): 巳 is filed under the radical 己.
巳.cn: Two theories: a fetus, or a snake (the Shuowen).

己.cn: A silk rope for binding things.

⻏.ja: おお (大, big) + ざと (さと, village): さと for a settlement, おお in contrast to こざと (阜).
⻏.cnNote: Shrunk to 阝 on the right side.

semantic.why: A large town (阝): a capital.
A part of a town (阝) or region.

⻖.ja: こ (小, small) + ざと (さと, village) + へん (left side): named in contrast to おおざと (邑).
⻖.cnNote: On the left side of a kanji, 阜 is written as 阝.

semantic.why: Steps going up a hill (阝): stairs, then floors.
Going down a hill (阝): descend.

⺖.ja: りっ (立, standing) + しん (心, heart) + べん (へん, left side): 心 standing upright on the left.
⺖.cnNote: Squeezed to fit the left side.

semantic.why: Feelings of the heart (忄).
A pleasant heart (忄).
Fear in the heart (忄).

⺨.ja: けもの (獣, beast) + へん (left side).
⺨.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the left side.

semantic.why: A cat is an animal (犭).
Hunting game with a dog (犭).

⺗.ja: した (下, below) + ごころ (こころ, 心, heart): 心 at the bottom.
⺗.cnNote: A changed shape of 心 used at the bottom of some kanji.

semantic.why: Respect is a feeling of the heart (⺗).
Longing is a feeling of the heart (⺗).

⺣.ja: れっ (列, row) + か (火, fire): fire written as a row of dots.
⺣.cnNote: Written as four dots at the bottom.

semantic.why: Heat from fire (灬).
Shining like fire (灬).

⺤.ja: つめ (爪, claw) + かんむり (top).

⺭.ja: しめす (示, altar) + へん (left side).
⺭.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the left side.

semantic.why: Gods, worshipped at an altar (礻).
An altar (礻) to the earth (土): a shrine.
Ancestors, honored at an altar (礻).

玉.cn: A piece of ritual jade; a dot sets it apart from 王.

氺.ja: した (下, below) + みず (水, water): 水 at the bottom.
氺.cnNote: A changed shape of 水 used at the bottom of some kanji (泰, 录).

⻂.ja: ころも (衣, garment) + へん (left side).
⻂.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the left side.

semantic.why: Mending clothes (衤).
Layered clothes (衤).

⺮.ja: たけ (竹, bamboo) + かんむり (top).

semantic.why: A tube of bamboo (⺮).
The joints of a bamboo (⺮) stem → section.
Bamboo (⺮) slips for writing, sorted by grade → rank, equal.

⻊.ja: あし (足, foot) + へん (left side).
⻊.cnNote: Changed in shape to fit the left side.

semantic.why: Where the feet (⻊) go: a road.
Footprints left by feet (⻊).
Stepping with the feet (⻊).

⻗.ja: あめ (雨, rain) + かんむり (top).

semantic.why: Snow falls like rain (⻗).
Clouds bring rain (⻗).
Lightning comes with rain (⻗).

龍.cn: A long, winding reptile with a crest and an open mouth: a dragon.

彑.ja: けい (彑, its reading) + がしら (top).

⺲.ja: あみ (網, net) + がしら (top).
⺲.cn: A net; on top it is often written 罒, which is not an eye (目).

semantic.why: Setting up a net (罒), then "put, place".
Spreading a net (罒) all around.
First a net (罒) laid out, then "role, office".

老.cn: A person with long hair (毛) leaning on a cane (匕): old.

䒑.ja: くさ (草, grass) + かんむり (top).
䒑.cn: Sometimes treated as a form of 艸, but in 前 it is a foot over a boat.

𠂉.ja: Written like katakana ノ (no) + 一 (いち, one).

｜.ja: たて (縦, vertical) + ぼう (棒, stick).
｜.cn: The Shuowen describes it as a vertical wooden stick.

ノ.cn: A stroke sweeping down to the left, not a picture; katakana ノ was made from 乃.

ヨ.ja: けい (彑, its reading) + がしら (top): the shape of 彑 on top.
ヨ.cn: A pig's snout (彑); in many kanji, such as 事 and 雪, the same shape is a hand.

⺩.ja: おう (王, king) + へん (left side).
⺩.cn: The form of 玉 (jade) on the left, written like 王.

semantic.why: Jade (⺩, a form of 玉) shaped into a ball.
First "to polish jade (⺩)"; "put in order, reason" likely grew from that.
A precious stone (⺩, jade): a pearl.
